The concept of **Organizational Practice** within this corpus highlights the structural and operational habits of specialized healthcare providers, particularly regarding patient engagement and education. A primary example of this is the operational model of the [[atrieflimren-klinik|Atrieflimren-klinik]], a multidisciplinary clinic operating under the umbrella of [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] [^src1].

A defining organizational practice for the Atrieflimren-klinik has been its sustained commitment to patient and family education. Since the clinic's establishment in 2012, it has maintained a continuous focus on educating patients and their relatives [^src1]. This long-standing practice illustrates how Hospitalsenhed Midt integrates educational initiatives into the foundational operations of its specialized clinical units, ensuring that care extends beyond direct medical treatment to include comprehensive support for patients and their families [^src1].
